$schema_note: Machine-enforced allowlist for the SCA (npm audit) gate. Read the policy first: docs/EXTERNAL_FINDINGS_POLICY.md. Enforced by tools/sca_gate.py (blocking CI step in .github/workflows/adversarial-review.yml). This file NEVER covers trust-invariant gates (trust_gate/evaluator/eval-harness/RLS) — it is only for external dependency/tooling findings we cannot fix under our own control.
rules_enforced_by_tool: Every high/critical production advisory MUST be either fixed or listed here — an unlisted one FAILS the gate.
An entry suppresses ONLY while the scanner reports fixAvailable=false for its package. The moment a fix ships, fixAvailable flips and the gate FAILS — forcing the upgrade (anti-rot).
An entry past its 'expires' date FAILS the gate — forcing periodic human + evaluator re-review.
A STALE entry (its advisory no longer appears in the audit — i.e. it was fixed/removed) FAILS the gate, forcing deletion so dead exceptions cannot accrete.
A malformed entry or an unreadable allowlist FAILS the gate (fail-closed).
Entries are scoped to an exact (package, ghsa). No wildcards.

entries.title: PostCSS: arbitrary file read / info disclosure via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL in CSS comments
entries.no_fix_reason: npm reports fixAvailable=false: every Next.js release in range pins this postcss; postcss cannot be bumped independently without breaking next. No stable upstream fix exists yet.
entries.operational_exposure: LOW / not reachable. postcss runs at BUILD time over OUR OWN authored CSS (Tailwind output), never over attacker-controlled input at runtime. The advisory needs an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL, which our build never ingests.
entries.resolution_trigger: Next.js publishes a release that depends on postcss >= 8.5.12 (npm audit fixAvailable flips to a version) -> bump next, delete this entry. Re-checked automatically on every web dependency change; hard re-review at expiry.

entries.title: sharp inherited libvips vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591)
entries.no_fix_reason: npm reports fixAvailable=false: sharp's version is bounded by the installed Next.js, which does not yet accept sharp >= 0.35.0. No stable upstream fix path without a next release.
entries.operational_exposure: LOW / not reachable at runtime. The consumer feed renders imagery via CSS background-image, NOT next/image, so sharp is never invoked in the request path. The libvips CVEs require processing attacker-supplied images through sharp, which this product does not do.
entries.resolution_trigger: Next.js publishes a release depending on sharp >= 0.35.0 (npm audit fixAvailable flips) -> bump next, delete this entry. Re-checked automatically on every web dependency change; hard re-review at expiry.
